editor.title: Format Your JSON Data
editor.help_text: Paste your JSON data to format, beautify, or minify it

content.why_desc: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is the most popular data interchange format used in web development, APIs, and configuration files. Our free online JSON formatter helps developers, data analysts, and IT professionals quickly format, beautify, validate, and minify JSON data. Whether you're debugging API responses, cleaning up configuration files, or preparing JSON for production, our tool provides instant results with syntax highlighting and error detection. Perfect for developers working with REST APIs, NoSQL databases, and modern web applications.

instant.title: Instant Formatting
instant.desc: Format and beautify JSON data in milliseconds with proper indentation and syntax highlighting

error.title: Error Detection
error.desc: Automatically detect and highlight JSON syntax errors with helpful error messages

privacy.title: 로컬 보안 처리
privacy.desc: 데이터는 서버로 절대 전송되지 않으며 오직 사용자의 브라우저 내에서만 머뭅니다.

content.how_title: How to Format JSON in 3 Easy Steps

1.title: Choose Action
1.desc: Click "Format & Beautify" to format or "Minify" to compress your JSON

2.title: Copy Result
2.desc: Click the copy button to copy the formatted JSON to your clipboard

3.title: Format or Minify
3.desc: Choose to beautify (format with indentation) or minify (compress to single line) your JSON data based on your needs.

api.title: API Response Debugging
api.desc: Format messy API responses to easily read and debug JSON data from REST APIs, GraphQL, and web services.

config.title: Configuration Files
config.desc: Clean up and validate JSON configuration files for applications, package.json, tsconfig.json, and more.

db.title: Database Data
db.desc: Format JSON data from NoSQL databases like MongoDB, CouchDB, and Firebase for better readability.

export.title: Data Export/Import
export.desc: Prepare JSON data for export or validate imported JSON data to ensure proper structure and syntax.

validate.title: ✓ Always Validate JSON
validate.desc: Use a JSON validator to catch syntax errors before deploying to production. Invalid JSON can break your application.

indent.title: ✓ Use Proper Indentation
indent.desc: Format JSON with 2 or 4 space indentation for better readability during development and debugging.

minify.title: ✓ Minify for Production
minify.desc: Minify JSON data before deploying to production to reduce file size and improve load times.

naming.title: ✓ Use Consistent Naming
naming.desc: Follow camelCase or snake_case naming conventions consistently throughout your JSON structure.

faq.a1: 네, 클라이언트 쪽에서만 연산이 일어나므로 민감한 데이터도 안심하고 확인하실 수 있습니다.
faq.a2: 오류가 있는 부분을 알려주며, 기본적인 구조 개선을 통해 최대한 유효한 형태가 되도록 돕습니다.
faq.a3: 현재는 직접 붙여넣기 방식을 통해 가장 빠른 처리를 지원하고 있습니다.
faq.q4: Does it support large JSON files?
faq.a4: Yes, the tool is optimized to handle large JSON datasets efficiently, though extremely large files might depend on your browser's memory limits.
